history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, nothing loads, and I can’t send picture messages. Can you help?

- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth

Once I have this information, I can assist you further.
My phone number is +1-617-555-0148 and my name is Sofia Martinez.

Your phone line is currently suspended due to an overdue bill from January, which is why you have no service and cannot send picture messages.

I have just sent you a payment request for the overdue amount of $65. Please check your payment requests and complete the payment. Once the bill is paid, I can help you restore your service. Let me know once you’ve made the payment or if you need further assistance with the payment process.

history.content: I rebooted my phone as you asked, but I still have no signal—no bars or service at all.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active but you still have no signal, let’s troubleshoot your phone’s connectivity.

Please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- Is Airplane Mode enabled?
- Do you see any signal bars or network icons (like 4G, 5G)?
- Is there any message like “No SIM” or “No Service”?

If you’re not sure, I can guide you through some steps to check these settings. Would you like instructions on how to check your status bar and SIM card status?
I just checked my status bar and it shows Excellent signal, 5G, Data Enabled, and Connected to Chestnut-5G. What should I try next?

Thank you for checking. Since your status bar shows excellent signal, 5G, and data enabled, your phone is connected to the network and should have service.

To confirm, can you try making a regular phone call or sending a text message? Also, are you able to use mobile data (for example, browsing the internet with Wi-Fi turned off)?

If you still cannot make calls, send texts, or use data, please let me know exactly what happens when you try, so I can assist you further.
I just tried sending a picture message and browsing the internet—both worked perfectly. Thanks, everything is working now!
I’m glad to hear that your service and picture messaging are working perfectly now! If you have any other questions or need assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
